name: Workspaces (per-monitor)
author: Greg DeYoung
description: Per-monitor workspaces: each monitor's bar shows its own block of workspaces as 1..9, 0, lit only while its monitor has focus. Companion to the Omarchy per-monitor workspaces engine (backported by gdeyoung.ultrawide-bar's hypr/ hook until the platform ships it).

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers for this monitor only (per-monitor blocks)
